message.content: {"findings":[{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"Expand","method":"extractFile","explanation":"In Expand.extractFile, the archive entry name received from ZipEntry.getName() is passed to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName) to produce File f, and new FileOutputStream(f) writes to that path without any check that f's canonical path is still under dir. A malicious entry name containing ../ or an absolute path can therefore escape the configured destination directory."}]}
